statement.en: EE is the positive exposure to the counterparty, ENE the bank's own, CVA a positive cost.
statement.es: EE es la exposicion positiva a la contraparte, ENE la propia del banco, CVA un costo positivo.

units.money: amount with its ISO 4217 currency code, USD in this case

fixed_rate_rule.value: the par yield at the swap's maturity on the curve date, rounded to 10 bp
fixed_rate_rule.label: convention

trades.floating_leg: USD floating leg on the single curve of the case
trades.label: convention

curve.source: US Treasury daily par yield curve (home.treasury.gov)

calibration_used.estimator: exact AR(1) OLS on the shortest Treasury zero rate (Brigo et al., arXiv 0812.4210, equations 55 to 57)
calibration_used.fit_to_curve: phi(t) = f(0,t) + sigma^2 (1 - exp(-a t))^2 / (2 a^2), the QuantLib 1.44 fitting parameter

measure_note.en: EE and ENE are undiscounted (Basel style); the discounted profiles feed the CVA.
measure_note.es: EE y ENE no estan descontados (estilo Basilea); los perfiles descontados alimentan el CVA.

csa.floor_reference: CRE53.24: 10 business days floor, 20 for illiquid or large netting sets

limit.en: The Andersen, Pykhtin and Sokol timelines are not modelled.
limit.es: No se modelan las cronologias de Andersen, Pykhtin y Sokol.

initial_margin.method: ORE dynamic initial margin by regression (R2)

limit.en: A regression proxy, never SIMM; compared with ORE's DIM on the same netting set.
limit.es: Un proxy de regresion, nunca SIMM; se compara con el DIM de ORE sobre el mismo conjunto.

cva_dva.credit_curve_label: proxy: an AAA to A market spread, a floor for lower ratings (R10)
cva_dva.negative_spread_rule: a negative HQM-minus-Treasury spread is set to zero and counted in spreads_floored_at_zero

limit.en: No official numeric example is verified; the tests rest on the invariants of dossier 01 M.1.
limit.es: No hay ejemplo numerico oficial verificado; las pruebas se apoyan en los invariantes.

backtest.calibration_rule: each initialisation date is calibrated on data up to that date only
